purpose: The precise shared baseline every Cycle 1 lane builds on. Astra reviewed a working snapshot, Git HEAD pointed somewhere else, and merged master was ahead of both. This records which is authoritative for what, so no later lane has to rediscover it.

staged_snapshot.note: The reviewed staged index, preserved as a reachable commit so it cannot be lost or garbage-collected. The working tree was never modified. Nothing was committed from it to a branch: its content is already in master.

master_only.resolution: Master wins. These are the §7/§12 codecs and lane records merged after the snapshot was taken.

adr_collisions.note: Astra and the executor allocate decision numbers from separate sessions with no shared counter, so collisions are expected rather than bad luck. Resolved by COMPARING CONTENT, not by deleting unexplained copies.

suite.note: Identical to merged master's numbers, as expected: this lane changes only docs/ and docs/planning. A first run WITHOUT the editor import pass reports ~37 phantom failures from unimported font/theme resources in any fresh worktree. An exit code of 0 is not evidence a test ran -- tools/run_tests.sh asserts on the runner's own summary line for that reason.
